title: Frame data
description: How a move resolves, written from its matched clip (F1, F2, F3). Frame numbers are 1-based from the move's first frame. Startup S, active A, recovery R: active frames are S+1..S+A.

active.description: null = '—' in rules.md: the body never hits; the projectile carries the hit (needs properties.projectile), or the move only teleports (properties.teleport, YOK-224: Fox Mirage 18/—/10).

pushback.description: Units the defender slides away on hit / block; omitted values use the fight default. A cornered defender passes the rest to the attacker.

strength.description: V2 hit strength: hitstop light 6, medium 9, heavy 12 frames (+4 on a counterhit); heavy hits also shake the screen (V3). Omitted: a normal takes it from its button (LP/LK light, MP/MK medium, HP/HK heavy), any other move is medium.

meter_gain.description: Overrides of the C5 attacker gains (+6 when it hits, +3 when it is blocked) for this move. The defender's +3 for a hit taken is not overridable.

hitboxes.description: 2D rectangles per active-frame range. Each range must sit inside the active window.

hurtboxes.description: Where the move can be hit, per frame range; ranges should cover the whole move.

cancel_windows.description: Frames in which a held cancel rule (X4) may fire out of this move.

hits.description: Hits taken per use of the move; omitted = 1 (the loader's default, YOK-103).

lifetime.description: Ticks before it fades; omit for screen edge.

angle_up.description: YOK-103: the projectile climbs as it flies (SimConfig.ProjectileAngleUpRisePct, proposed).

max_active.description: How many of the owner's projectiles from this move may be on screen at once; omitted = 1 (YOK-21: one per owner).

aftershock_delay.description: YOK-136 (Oni Quake Lv 3 Aftershock, A5): frames after the move's first active frame that a second quake replays the move's hitboxes, anchored where the first struck. Needs the move's own hitboxes; one connect, with the move's numbers.

throw.description: Generic throw (C4) fired by a special's input (YOK-225, a command grab): grab clip + standard knockdown, never paired animation. It resolves as the LP+LK throw does and counts as a throw for trials (R7) and successful_throws cancels (X4). Specials only; not with aftershock_delay; the recovery must outlast break_window (E12).

range.description: YOK-225: on a special, makes it a command grab (River Grab): its hitboxes place the grab, which reaches from each box's x to range units in front of the thrower; they never strike, so no hitstun is needed. An effect target (Whirlpool Grab: mul_pct 150). Must reach past every hitbox's x.

breakable.description: false: the defender's LP+LK press does not break it (a clash still does).

break_window.description: Frames the defender has to break it; omitted = 7 (C4).

wall_bounce.description: YOK-220 (Crushing Charge, Iron-Club Charge Lv 3): the hit bounces the opponent off the wall. Loads; no fight code reads it yet.

decoy.description: YOK-220 (Mirage Feint, Fox Mirage Lv 3): hits the decoy absorbs. YOK-224: a teleport leaves it at the origin (MoveData.ReadMirage, Match.Mirage); a move without a teleport leaves none.

forward_travel.description: Units moved forward over the move (YOK-220: a level, EX or modifier effect can add or set it, Torrent Spin). A modifier's string "charge_dash" on this target is the Sumo Stance switch (YOK-171), never written here.

counterhit_immune.description: YOK-103: a hit during this move is never a counterhit (C7).

projectile_interrupt_immune.description: YOK-103: projectile hits deal damage but don't interrupt the move.

throw_break.description: AM12 (YOK-172): a throw that would grab the fighter during this move's startup breaks automatically: a clash, no damage, like throw vs throw. Not throw-invulnerability (E17).

pull_on_hit.description: YOK-103: on hit the defender is pulled this many steps toward the attacker instead of pushed (step = SimConfig.PullStepUnits, proposed).

heal_pct_max_health.description: YOK-103: on hit the attacker heals this % of its max health.
